native_title: あなたの子だけが欲しいです

titles.title: あなたの子だけが欲しいです

description:
Juliana entered into a political marriage with Karion, the heir to a rival family and the man she had secretly loved for ten years.

However, all she received in return was cruel treatment and the heartbreaking death of her son, Denian, who had been her only source of comfort.

Driven to despair, Juliana attempted to take her own life. But inexplicably, she found herself transported back to the moment just before her marriage to Karion.

And it happened again and again.

Determined to escape Karion and live a new life, Juliana tried to change her fate. Yet no matter how many times she returned to the past, she could never forget her beloved son, Denian.

And so, on her twelfth regression, Juliana makes a surprising decision: she will marry Karion once again.

"Karion, I don't need love in our marriage."

"In this life, all I want is your child."
